text: Put baking soda on the back of your neck and you will not believe what happens. Mix one tablespoon of baking soda with two tablespoons of coconut oil until it forms a paste. Apply it to the back of your neck and leave it for 20 minutes. Coconut oil restores your skin's natural tone and the baking soda lifts the darkness and spots that have been building up for years. You can use this on your elbows, armpits, knees and inner thighs, anywhere you want to see results. Do this once a week and I promise you will thank me. But I want you to understand something. Those dark patches and that dull skin do not appear just because of the sun or friction. In Chinese medicine, darkened skin in certain areas of the body is a sign that something inside is not working properly. A dark neck can be a sign of insulin resistance. Dark elbows and knees reflect a body that has been inflamed for a long time. Dark armpits often have to do with a hormonal imbalance. Your skin is a map of what is happening inside of you and what is happening inside does not darken. Just because of food, stress disrupts your hormones, accumulated tension inflames your body and inflammation darkens the skin. The emotions you never release overload the liver and an overloaded liver shows directly in your skin tone. This paste brightens the outside, but if on the inside nothing changes, the dark patches come back right in the comments. New skin if you are going to try this week and if you want to learn how to cleanse your body from where it truly begins, to calm what inflames, to balance what is out of alignment and to let your skin reflect on the outside the peace you deserve to feel on the inside. I spent over twenty years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
